methods.label: Absolute-value properties and zero
methods.explanation: Two additive inverses are the same distance from the origin, so their absolute values are equal. Numbers whose absolute values equal themselves are nonnegative (including \(0\)); the absolute value of \(0\) is \(0\); the number with the smallest absolute value is \(0\).
methods.levelReason: Uses Grade 7 absolute-value properties, additive inverses, and the special role of zero.
